After-review round - independent

The Initiatives tab as shipped: the map survived, the reading rank did not

I ran the panel from this tree, opened the Initiatives tab in a real browser at 1440, 1024, 768 and the 480 rail, with a real initiative carrying two projects and three waves, and set the shipped thing against round A's direction B, The Route, and round B's eight must-survive items and 6.2 contracts. The restyle kept every fact and almost every control; it lowered the folded description's ink, broke the one reading edge by 37px, moved New initiative behind two new controls, and left a scroll gate red that passed at the commit before it.

Reviewed d0df8ca (main, 1.157.3) Product da17dce, PR 852 17 captures, 5 widths 4 gates and one full suite No product code changed

Verdict: the restyle kept the map and lost the reading rank. Every count, fold, tree, task, history line and wave fact is still there; the route is drawn correctly; the lane is the most organised surface in the tab. But the folded preview is drawn in the count ink at 4.5:1 on hover where round B assigned the body ink at 8.8:1 and the old tab recorded 6.7:1, the row that has a route starts 37px right of the rows that do not, and the primary New initiative is now third behind About and Compact rows. The evidence is weaker than the round's account: the contrast gate never measures the folded preview or the wave lane, the open caret's test was loosened, and a scroll gate that passed 33/33 at the parent fails 31/33 here and was not run in the round.

The two sentences to keep: no fact was lost, and one gate is red. The first is the redesign's success; the second is why I would not call it finished on the current evidence.

What is right, and should be protected

  • The map is complete. Old and new open cards are equal for every count, description, project, tree, branch, assistant, task, history line, empty sentence and worktree link. Only the header actions, the help paragraph's home and the section-head wording changed.
  • The route reads at a glance. Three dots in the wave's own state, the current one ringed, a 5px status dot and the word "W2 running"; the title steps to 15.5px; the glyph is decorative and the word is the answer.
  • The lane is the best surface in the tab. A 2px state spine, a 22px station, lanes 637px each side by side at 1440, a 44/150/80 member manifest inside a lane, and the old 3.84:1 wave texts raised to 4.8.
  • The honesty survived. Unreadable stores are said, unresolved templates are named, skipped waves are listed, no state is invented, and the refusal path no longer promises a join it cannot make (pinned by the new tests).
  • The keyboard layer is better than before. One ring, one restored focus, a density setting that changes space only, and a tab order in reading order. Zero page and console errors in every probe.
  • The change is contained. Tokens are scoped to #as-initiatives, there is no second palette, no dependency was added, and the panel still serves 1.157.3 and its live board was read, with this tree attached through the panel's own route.

06 Findings, ranked

One blocker, five should-fix, five taste. The blocker is evidence, not a lost fact; the first three should-fix items are the ones I would put in the same change as the report.

1

The scroll gate is red, and the round did not run it

Blocker

A gate that passed at the parent fails at the shipped commit, and the round's green list omits it.

Evidence
node tools/verify-initiatives-scroll.mjs answers 31/33 at d0df8ca and 33/33 on the archived parent c2692598. The two failures are tools/verify-initiatives-scroll.mjs:324 ("the last card's box is inside the pane's visible box - last 133..880 in 173..900") and :334 ("the last card is still in view - last 133..880"). The scroll position itself is preserved: scrollTop 8612 before and 8612 after the re-read. The last expanded card is 747px tall in a 727px pane, so its whole box cannot be inside; the gate demands the whole box, not the reachable bottom. The round's gate list is tab, waves-lane and redesign; the scroll gate is not in it.
Why it matters
This is the only red gate in the review, and it is a gate the redesign's own card growth crossed. The product still reaches the bottom of the list, but the round cannot claim "all gates green", and a future regression in the scroll restore would now be hidden behind a gate that is already red.
What I would change
Either repair the assertion to check that the last card's bottom is inside the pane and the scroll is at its maximum (the reachable edge), with the reason in the tool's header, or reduce the open card's height so the old whole-box assertion can pass. Rerun the gate, put it in the round's gate list, and do not call the set green until it is.
2

The folded preview is drawn in the count ink, at the AA floor on hover

Should-fix

The redesign's most-read text fell from 6.7:1 to 4.5:1, and the gate's headline says 5.0.

Evidence
#as-initiatives .init-card.is-titlecard .init-desc { color: var(--tab-ink-3) } (public/style.css:5185); --tab-ink-3: #7f8a9a (:4889). Measured composited: 4.90:1 at rest on the ground #171c24, 4.50:1 on the hover fill #1c2330 at 768 and 480. B's role table gives the description --tab-ink-2 #aeb8c6, 8.8:1; the old tab's description was --dim #9aa4b2 and B recorded 6.7:1. The redesign gate's "worst 5:1 at .init-chips .chip" is the open-card sample, not the folded preview: the sample is [title, description, chip, hint, fold, tree, mini, assist] (tools/initiatives-measure.mjs:442-446) and the folded preview is a different element on a different background. The count chips and provenance also measure 4.50 on the hover fill, below B's 5.0 counts role; the wave's 10px project tag is 4.51, which is the one pair B named as the floor.
What I would change
Restore --tab-ink-2 for .init-card.is-titlecard .init-desc, keep ink-3 for counts and provenance, and add the folded selector plus the folded row's composited background to the contrast sample. If the counts' 4.50 on hover is unwanted, raise their ink too or stop tinting the fill under them; the 10px project tag can stay at 4.51 because that is its named role.
3

The route row breaks the one reading edge by 37px

Should-fix

The ledger's left edge is ragged exactly where the new route mark sits.

Evidence
#as-initiatives .init-card.is-titlecard.has-route { padding-left: 45px } (public/style.css:5131) against the folded row's padding: 12px 8px (:5062): a 37px difference. Measured title lefts: 977 for Kafka, Sweeper and Release, 1014 for Menu at 1440 dock (437/474 at 768; 257/294 at 480; 25/62 at 1440 float). The spread is 37 everywhere. The open card is aligned (986, 986, 986 at 1440 dock; 34 at 1440 float), and the redesign gate's 16/16 alignment check samples only that open card. B's #4 says one left edge, and B's old rubric recorded 982 x5 + 998, a 16px spread. The CSS comment says the title, preview and counts share one edge inside the row, which is true; the ledger's rows do not share one edge with each other.
What I would change
Reserve the 45px gutter on every folded row (a 27px spacer or the same padding with the glyph only on route rows), or move the glyph into the right-side caret column so every title starts at 977. Add a folded-list alignment check to tools/initiatives-measure.mjs that measures all four rows and holds the spread to 16px, the old rubric's own number.
4

New initiative moved from first to third, and the toolbar wraps at 768

Should-fix

The primary action is now behind a help disclosure and a density setting, and the four actions do not fit one row in the 347px pane.

Evidence
Old header buttons: New initiative, Refresh. New: About, Compact rows, New initiative, Refresh (public/assistant.js:4052-4055); the keyboard order is About, Compact rows, New initiative, Refresh, then the four card heads. At 768 the toolbar is two rows and Refresh is alone on the second (08a); at 480 it is 2x2 (11a); at 1024 and 1440 it is one row. The brief says a reordered group is a finding, and the tab's primary action is now third in every path.
What I would change
Order New initiative, Refresh, About, Compact rows; make the four fit at 347 by shortening "Compact rows" to "Density" or a 4px toggle, or move About and Compact to the meta row. Add a toolbar-row check at 347 and 239 to the tab gate so a future control cannot silently orphan Refresh again.
5

The contrast gate's sample never enters the lane or the folded row

Should-fix

The gate is green on a sample that cannot see the two places the contrast changed.

Evidence
tools/initiatives-measure.mjs:442-446 still samples [title, description, chip, hint, fold, tree, mini, assist]; B 6.1 explicitly asked the round to add .wave-gate, .wave-auto and .wave-member-project, and the redesign left the file unchanged (git diff --stat c2692598 01c22b3f -- tools/initiatives-measure.mjs is empty). The true worst is 4.50 at .wave-member-project and at the folded preview/counts on hover; the gate reports 5.0 at .init-chips .chip. chips-fit also passes when the list is empty because it only checks clipped.length === 0 (:459).
What I would change
Add the three lane selectors, .init-card.is-titlecard .init-desc, .init-chips .chip and .init-meta to the sample, use the composited background of the folded row/hover fill, and report the true worst. Make chips-fit skip an empty sample rather than pass it. Keep the 4.5 floor, but stop claiming a 5.0 worst when 4.5 is measured.
6

The open caret's test was loosened

Should-fix

A regression that drops the open card's caret would pass the gate.

Evidence
git diff c2692598 01c22b3f -- tools/verify-initiatives-tab.mjs: the open assertion changed from /^▾/ to !/▸$/ (tools/verify-initiatives-tab.mjs:464). The shipped open caret is drawn by CSS, not in the head text, so the new assertion only checks that the folded glyph is not at the end; it does not check that the open glyph exists. The folded assertion still checks endsWith("▸"). The visual open caret is in captures 05 and 09.
What I would change
Assert the open caret itself (the computed ::after content or a class/glyph element) together with aria-expanded=true, and keep the folded assertion. This is a one-line test repair, and it is the one place where the redesign's test change met the code rather than the code meeting the test.
7

The wide plate spreads two short project rows across 810px, and the flat wave member stops at 760

Taste

The 1440 floating panel has the width; the two places that could use it are the two places that do not.

Evidence
The wide grid is 498.094px 809.906px (public/style.css:5607-5623); the Projects side is 810px wide (x 556..1366) and 127px tall, with "Menu" at x 580 and its "1 tree" at x 1343; the description is capped at 458px and leaves 64px before the side's border. In the lane, .wave-member { max-width: 760px } (public/style.css:5544-5549) leaves more than 500px of W1's 1332px lane blank after the state chip. A's direction B proposed a 360px projects column; no information is lost at 810.
What I would change
Cap the Projects side at 360-400px and give the words the rest, or make the side a two-column list and move Assistants/History into it; drop the 760px cap for a member row outside a lane (keep it inside a lane, where the lane is 637px).
8

The provenance drops below the counts at 479 on the route row, and on every row at 768/480

Taste

B's same-row promise survives only where the status pill is absent.

Evidence
At 1440 dock the Kafka row's counts and "edited 3h ago..." share a line; the Menu row's "W2 running" pushes its provenance to the next line (04a). At 1024 the Menu row wraps and the Kafka row does not (07); at 768 and 480 all rows wrap (08a, 11a). The CSS is .init-chips { flex-wrap: wrap } and .init-meta { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-left: auto } (public/style.css:5194, :5219); the old tab forced the meta onto its own row at every width (git show c2692598:public/style.css:4893). The new is an improvement at 1440, not the promised row at the widths the brief names.
What I would change
Either shrink the gaps and the status margin so the route row keeps the meta on the same line at 479, or make the two-line counts/provenance pattern deliberate and document it; test all four widths. At 239, the three-line pattern is acceptable only if the section head stays visible.
9

The current and opened-by violet is outside B's token table

Taste

One extra hue, on a surface that already carries the current row's raise.

Evidence
#as-initiatives .wave-auto-open.is-on { color: #d8c7ff; border-color: #5b4a86; background: rgba(163, 113, 247, 0.14) } (public/style.css:5492); the same violet family is used for the current pill. B's six state roles are ready, run, warn, bad, idle and done; there is no violet in the table. The old tab used violet for the current wave, so the family is not new; the "opened by" pill is a second use.
What I would change
Either use the raised surface and ink-2 for current/opened-by (B 4.2 already says the current wave is raised), or add a named --tab-violet token to the table and use it for both pills so the next restyle can find it.
10

A skipped-only wave store is summarized as "no waves"

Taste

The folded row overstates emptiness for an initiative whose only wave record was refused.

Evidence
The init_sweeper state fixture: the folded status is "no waves"; opening it shows the refused record beside the lane (14-state-skipped-sweeper.jpg). The wave head says "read from the wave store" and the open card is honest, but the folded summary does not say "1 refused" or "no valid waves". B #7 says skipped waves are listed; they are, one press away.
What I would change
When waves.length === 0 && waveStatus.skipped.length > 0, label the status "no valid waves" or "1 refused" in public/core/initiative-fold.js, and add a test for the skipped-only case beside the unreadable and 2-wave cases.
11

The join line says "names them all" without naming the lanes

Taste

The two names are directly below it, but the sentence is the one that promises them.

Evidence
public/core/waves-lane.js:143: ${laneCount} lanes - closing this wave is ONE commit that names them all; the W2 text is "2 lanes - ... names them all"; the lane heads below say "lane cookie - running" and "lane login - done". The test asserts the sentence and the data-wave-join="2", but not the names (test/waves-lane.test.js:306-307). B 4.1's join field names the lanes.
What I would change
Render the lane names from lanes.map(l => l.name) in the join ("cookie and login - closing this wave is ONE commit") and assert both names in the test; keep the refusal branch's no-join assertion exactly as it is.

The full suite, once

npm test answered 3589 tests: 3582 pass, 7 fail, 0 skipped. The seven failures are all outside the Initiatives tab, and this branch changes no product code (the report, its captures and a version bump only), so none is attributable to the branch:

TestWhat it said

test/junctioned-node-modules.test.js:130"git worktree remove walks THROUGH a junctioned node_modules": "the tree it was asked to remove is gone" true !== false. A Windows junction/worktree removal, not the tab.
test/paths-http.test.js:150"Clean scratch over HTTP": "the Settings row can say so before anyone presses the button" true !== false. Paths/settings, not the tab.
test/paths.test.js:221"every *File / *Dir / *Log config key is derived": pipelineBundleSeedFile at lib/pipeline-bundle-import.js:321 is not in statePaths(). A real config-key gap in the product, unrelated to this round.

test/scan-roots.test.js:51"the repo under the new folder is on the board without a restart" undefined !== true; scan/settings, not the tab.

I did not fix them: the brief says no product code in this round, and none is in the Initiatives diff. The redesign's own tests, the four gates, the tab's 89/89 and the lane's 40/40 are green except for the scroll gate (F1). The suite ran once, as the brief asks; its log is npm-test.log in the scratch run, and the seven lines above are the failing set verbatim.

The five deleted lines, read. The preview and worktree font assertions were updated from 11.5px to 12.5px, which is the shipped body step; that is a test following a design step, not a test hiding a regression. The folded head assertion is stronger. The open head assertion is the one that got weaker: ^▾ pinned the open caret, !/▸$/ only says the folded caret is gone. B promised 13px for the body; the shipped step is 12.5 and the test now pins 12.5, so nothing catches the half-pixel shortfall. The earlier comment at public/assistant.js:3718 still says 11.5px, which is stale.

The smallest set that makes the tab match B and the evidence match the tab. The first three are one change; the last five can wait for a follow-up.

What I did not do

No product code was changed in this round. The branch carries the report, its captures and the measurements, plus a version bump for the landing. No git worktree was created to compare or export a branch: the parent is git archive c2692598 under scratch. The live ~/.wag store was not edited by hand; this tree was attached to init_mwrhmpv3_g96jpk through POST /api/initiatives/move, recorded at 2026-11-22T18:59:17.827Z. The 7331 panel stayed up, pid 42968. The scratch browser and its profile were closed; only the panel's own browser remains. The old gate could not be replayed, and the report says so rather than inventing a number. The 1024 floating pane and the 480 open-card body were not captured, and the report says which capture stands in.
